SECTION 01

Corporate Entity & Jurisdictional Scope

This Corporate Privacy Policy applies to all digital platforms, software engineering engagements, custom cloud architectures, consulting services, and applications operated by Coralgenz Global ("we", "us", "our", or the "Company"), headquartered in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India.

Statutory Data Fiduciary Identification: Under Section 2(i) of the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (India), Coralgenz Global serves as the Data Fiduciary determining the purpose and means of processing personal data. Under Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR), Coralgenz Global serves as the Data Controller for corporate website visitors and enterprise client points of contact.

For specialized products with separate architectural zero-knowledge guarantees—specifically Coralgenz Vault and the proprietary .secure container format—please refer to our dedicated Coralgenz Vault Zero-Knowledge Privacy Architecture, which details mathematical client-side non-custody.

SECTION 02

Categories of Personal & Technical Data Collected

We strictly enforce the principle of data minimization (collecting only what is strictly necessary to fulfill your technical inquiries and execute enterprise engineering contracts). We categorize collected information into three distinct tiers:

Data Category Specific Items Collected Collection Method Mandatory / Optional
Direct Enterprise Inquiries Full Name, Corporate Email Address, Organization Name, Contact Phone, Technical Requirements Summary Submitted via Contact Form, Email, or RFP Intake Desk Required for technical discovery & commercial proposals
Project Execution & Authentication Authorized developer emails, SSH public keys, Git commit metadata, IP whitelist records for staging environments Enterprise client provisioning & repository invitations Required to execute software engineering agreements
Automated Technical Telemetry Origin IP address (anonymized), browser user-agent, operating system, timestamp, request URI, HTTP status code Server access logs & edge CDN routing (Vercel / Cloudflare) Automatically logged for network defense & DDoS prevention
Proprietary Client Code & Data Schema definitions, source code repositories, API payloads Bilateral GitHub / Gitlab / AWS client-owned tenancy Covered under Bilateral NDA (See Section 04)
SECTION 03

Purpose of Processing & Statutory Lawful Grounds

In accordance with Section 4 of India’s DPDP Act 2023 and Article 6 of the EU GDPR, Coralgenz Global processes personal data solely upon verified lawful grounds:

  • 1. Performance of a Contract (GDPR Art. 6(1)(b) / DPDP Sec. 4): Delivering custom software development, frontend modernization, cloud deployments, code refactoring, and maintaining enterprise service level agreements (SLAs).
  • 2. Unambiguous Explicit Consent (DPDP Sec. 6 / GDPR Art. 6(1)(a)): Collected when you submit our contact forms, schedule technical consultations, or opt-in to technical product advisories. Consent may be revoked at any time.
  • 3. Compliance with Legal Obligations (DPDP Sec. 7 / GDPR Art. 6(1)(c)): Maintaining corporate tax, commercial billing audits, financial transaction compliance under Indian law, and responding to lawful statutory process.
  • 4. Legitimate Interests & Cyber Defense (GDPR Art. 6(1)(f)): Monitoring network integrity, preventing cross-site scripting (XSS), mitigating brute-force attacks, and securing cloud infrastructure.
SECTION 04

Enterprise Codebase Segregation & Mutual NDA Safeguards

Unlike consumer SaaS vendors, Coralgenz Global is an enterprise engineering partner. We understand that your source code, business logic, algorithmic models, and database architectures represent irreplaceable intellectual property.

Bilateral NDA by Default: Prior to reviewing proprietary repositories or architecture blueprints, Coralgenz Global executes standard mutual Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs). We guarantee that client codebases are never used to train generative AI models, never shared across client boundaries, and never stored on unencrypted developer machines.
  • Isolated Development Environments: Code checkouts occur strictly within encrypted, access-controlled workstations adhering to AES-256 full disk encryption (FileVault / BitLocker).
  • Zero-Telemetry Code Policy: We do not inject tracking scripts, commercial telemetry, or phone-home beacons into custom software produced for enterprise clients.
  • Complete Client IP Ownership: All custom source code, build scripts, deployment configs, and container definitions transfer 100% to the client upon milestone settlement.
SECTION 05

Third-Party Processors & Cross-Border Transfers

We do not sell, rent, or trade personal data. Period. To operate our corporate web infrastructure and communications, we engage certified infrastructure sub-processors who meet SOC 2 Type II, ISO/IEC 27001, and GDPR compliance criteria:

Sub-processor Service Rendered Data Center Location Transfer Safeguards
Vercel Inc. Edge Hosting, SSL Provisioning, DNS Routing Global Anycast Edge / United States Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs), DPA
Amazon Web Services (AWS) Cloud Infrastructure & Isolated Build Engines ap-south-1 (Mumbai, India) / us-east-1 ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPAA, DPDP Alignment
Google Workspace Corporate Email & Inquiries Routing India & Global Distributed Clusters Enterprise TLS 1.3 Encryption, GDPR DPA

Whenever personal data is transferred across international boundaries, Coralgenz Global ensures compliance with Chapter IV of GDPR and Section 16 of India’s DPDP Act 2023, utilizing Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) and verified technical safeguards.

SECTION 06

Data Retention Periods & Cryptographic Sanitization

Personal data is retained only for the duration necessary to satisfy the purpose for which it was collected, or to comply with statutory accounting and commercial obligations:

  • Commercial Inquiries & Consultations: Retained for 24 months from the last substantive communication, after which records are archived or permanently purged.
  • Enterprise Contract & Billing Records: Retained for 7 years as mandated by Indian statutory tax, corporate, and financial reporting legislation.
  • Server Access & Security Logs: Retained for a rolling period of 90 days for forensic monitoring and automated intrusion analysis, then securely rotated and deleted.
  • Client Source Code & Test Environments: Scrubbed and permanently purged from Coralgenz developer workstations within 30 days of final project sign-off and warranty completion.
SECTION 07

Your Statutory Rights (DPDP Act 2023, GDPR, CCPA)

Depending on your jurisdiction, you possess enforceable legal rights regarding your personal data. Coralgenz Global provides direct, unhindered mechanisms to exercise these rights:

Right to Access & Summary

Request a complete summary of personal data being processed by us, including the identities of any data fiduciaries or processors with whom it was shared.

Right to Correction & Erasure

Correct inaccurate or misleading personal data, complete incomplete entries, or request permanent deletion when processing is no longer legally warranted.

Right to Nominate (DPDP Sec. 14)

Under India's DPDP Act, nominate an individual who will exercise your data rights in the event of death or legal incapacity.

Right to Restrict & Opt-Out

Withdraw previously granted consent at any time without punitive consequences, or object to specific processing activities under GDPR/CCPA.

How to Exercise Your Rights: Submit an email request directly to our Data Protection & Grievance Desk at grievance@coralgenz.co.in or contact@coralgenz.co.in. We acknowledge receipt within 24 hours and resolve requests within 30 statutory days without charge.
SECTION 08

Technical, Administrative & Physical Safeguards

Coralgenz Global implements defense-in-depth security controls aligned with ISO/IEC 27001 principles and SOC 2 Type II audit baselines:

  • Transport Layer Security: All web and API traffic is enforced over TLS 1.3 with strict HSTS (HTTP Strict Transport Security) and modern cryptographic cipher suites.
  • Data at Rest Encryption: Cloud databases, backups, and staging disks are protected with hardware-accelerated AES-256 encryption.
  • Role-Based Access Control (RBAC): Employee access to production infrastructure adheres to least privilege principles, requiring hardware MFA (FIDO2 / U2F) and ephemeral VPN tunnels.
  • Vulnerability Management: Continuous dependency scanning, static code analysis (SAST), dynamic application security testing (DAST), and periodic third-party penetration audits.
SECTION 09

Statutory Grievance Redressal Mechanism (DPDP Act 2023)

In compliance with Section 8(10) and Section 13 of India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, Coralgenz Global has designated an official Grievance Redressal Officer to address user concerns, rights applications, and data protection inquiries.

Designated Grievance Officer

Corporate Compliance & Data Protection Unit, Coralgenz Global

Official Grievance Email: grievance@coralgenz.co.in
Headquarters: Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu 641001, India
Response SLA: Guaranteed Initial Acknowledgment within 24-48 Hours

Regulatory Escalation Protocol

If you are unsatisfied with our internal grievance redressal or do not receive a resolution within the statutory timeline, you possess the legal right under Section 13(3) of the DPDP Act 2023 to file an appeal directly with the Data Protection Board of India.

EU residents may lodge a complaint with their local supervisory Data Protection Authority (DPA) under Article 77 of the GDPR.

SECTION 10

Cookies, Session Storage & Tracking Disclosures

Our website uses strictly necessary cookies and local storage tokens required for functional operation, security verification, and UI state preferences.

  • Strictly Necessary Storage: Local storage keys utilized to cache UI theme states, language preferences, and CSRF token defenses.
  • Zero Third-Party Ad Pixels: We do not deploy Meta Pixel, Google AdSense, behavioral retargeting beacons, or commercial data-harvesting trackers on coralgenz.co.in.
  • Privacy-Preserving Telemetry: Any performance monitoring used to improve page load metrics is cookieless, aggregated, and completely decoupled from individual user profiles.
SECTION 11

Frequently Asked Compliance Questions

How does Coralgenz Global handle children's data?
Our engineering services, digital products, and enterprise solutions are strictly designed for businesses and individuals aged 18 and older. We do not knowingly solicit or collect personal data from minors under Section 9 of the DPDP Act 2023 or the US COPPA. Any inadvertent data collected is purged immediately upon notification.
How often is this Privacy Policy updated?
We review and update this policy semiannually to reflect evolving statutory guidelines under the DPDP Rules 2025/2026, GDPR case law, and international frameworks. Material modifications will be flagged via a notice on our homepage 30 days prior to enforcement.
How is Coralgenz Vault's privacy different from this corporate policy?
This policy governs corporate communications, client consulting, and general website operations. Coralgenz Vault is an isolated zero-knowledge cryptographic product where data is encrypted client-side using AES-256-GCM and PBKDF2 before reaching any server, making server-side inspection mathematically impossible. View the full architectural details on our Coralgenz Vault Zero-Knowledge Policy.
